entities.title: The Godot project
entities.summary: The game itself, for Godot 4.7: one scene whose script builds the arena, lighting, camera and HUD in code, and the riders, trails and effects.
entities.purpose: scenes/main.tscn is one node; scripts/main.gd runs rounds and resolves collisions, scripts/light_cycle.gd is a rider (movement, trail walls, AI, model, crash), scripts/minimap.gd draws the radar, shaders/ holds the light-wall and grid-floor shaders, and tests/ holds the headless test.
boundaries: No imported assets: every mesh, material and effect is made in code or a shader.
Collision does not use the physics engine: riders move on axis-aligned lines, so every trail segment is a rectangle in the XZ plane, and each tick sweeps each rider's front against them.
web_shell/ and tests/ are left out of the export (export_presets.cfg).
